meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 把你本地的 Flask、Django 或 FastAPI 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux；缺资源组、计划、Web 应用时自动创建，设好启动命令与构建开关后部署，最后打印部署后提示。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”等关键词，或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时触发；不用于容器应用、Functions、IaC。

say.text: 把这个 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 会自动创建资源组、计划和应用

say.text: 用 azd 把 Django 项目部署到 App Service Linux
say.note: 检测到 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署

howto.what_en: Deploys your local Flask, Django or FastAPI code to Azure App Service Linux. It creates the resource group, plan and web app if missing, sets the startup command and build flag, deploys, then prints the post-deploy message.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Flask App Service" or ask to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, IaC or non-Python work.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Creates the resource group, plan and app

say_en.text: Deploy my Django project with azd to App Service Linux
say_en.note: Uses azd when azure.yaml is present

say_en.text: Deploy my FastAPI app to App Service with uvicorn
